confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LiDAR Composite and SurfZone metadata indexes now supplied as GeoPackage
verified_facts: EA states LiDAR Composite and SurfZone download ZIPs contain a spatial metadata index in GeoPackage format.
The index describes spatial location and temporal extent of raster elevation data and the relevant metadata record provides technical schema guidance.
semantic_limits: GeoPackage metadata is lineage/discovery evidence, not an elevation sample.
Parcel survey identity remains unknown until the exact spatial metadata feature is matched.

candidates.name: National Geoid Model OSGM15
verified_facts: OSGM15 converts ETRS89 ellipsoid heights to orthometric heights.
On mainland Britain it provides ODN heights; some islands use specific local vertical datums.
semantic_limits: A geoid-model definition does not prove which transformation a specific EA survey used.
Parcel lineage must retain the survey-specific transformation field.

candidates.name: Future of British mapping coordinate systems
verified_facts: OS states OSGB36 and ODN remain the basis of OS mapping.
OSTN15 and OSGM15 provide transformations from ETRS89 to OSGB36 and ODN for GNSS-based access.
semantic_limits: National transformation context must not override survey-specific EA metadata.
Horizontal and vertical transformation roles remain separate.

candidates.name: Download Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
verified_facts: The July 2026 INSPIRE files were published 5 July 2026.
HMLR states new files are published on the first Sunday of every month and downloads are organised by local authority.
semantic_limits: Monthly publication date is dataset freshness, not title-plan survey date.
Local-authority packaging can duplicate boundary-crossing polygons and requires identity de-duplication.

candidates.name: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE) dataset page
verified_facts: HMLR describes INSPIRE polygons as showing position and indicative extent of registered freehold property.
Each polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title; files are GML and updated monthly.
semantic_limits: INSPIRE geometry is indicative, not a determined legal boundary.
INSPIRE ID linkage is title discovery/provenance, not terrain measurement evidence.

candidates.name: Land registration: Data collection
verified_facts: The official collection routes users to INSPIRE Index Polygons, National Polygon Service and the Geospatial Data Catalogue under spatial data.
It provides the current authoritative discovery hub for HM Land Registry public datasets.
semantic_limits: Catalogue routing is provenance evidence only.
A catalogue entry does not itself establish polygon exactness or elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: Public data
verified_facts: HM Land Registry lists INSPIRE Index Polygons among datasets available under the Open Government Licence.
The page separates OGL public data from other licensed datasets.
semantic_limits: Open licence does not imply exact legal-boundary geometry.
Free availability does not change parcel measurement uncertainty.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Documentation
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 is an open Great Britain DTM with 50m grid spacing and 10m contours.
OS states the product is updated annually in July and offers GML, ASCII, shapefile, vector-tile and GeoPackage forms.
semantic_limits: Terrain 50 remains a coarse secondary cross-check.
Multiple formats derived from one source do not create independent measurements.
